summary: Iteration 100: Custom Panel System (Phase 1) testing complete. All 18 backend pytest tests passed. Backend APIs for panel CRUD, field management, access control, and validation are working correctly. Frontend correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login. The panels page compiles without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ GET /api/business-tools/access-level returns 'advanced' for dev-test user with correct limits (maxPanels: 10, maxFieldsPerPanel: 20)
✓ POST /api/business-tools/panels creates panel with all 8 field types (text, number, date, dropdown, multiselect, boolean, longtext, relation)
✓ GET /api/business-tools/panels returns list of panels with count and limit
✓ GET /api/business-tools/panels/{id} returns single panel with all field details
✓ POST /api/business-tools/panels/{id}/fields adds new field to existing panel
✓ GET /api/business-tools/panels/linkable-targets returns system modules (inventory, invoices) and custom panels
✓ Duplicate panel name validation returns 400 with 'already exists' message
✓ Dropdown/multiselect without options returns 400 with validation error
✓ Relation field without relatedPanel returns 400 with validation error
✓ Max 20 fields per panel limit enforced (returns 400 for 21 fields)
seed_data_creation: Test panels created with TEST_ prefix are cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 100 tested the Custom Panel System (Phase 1). All backend APIs work correctly with dev-test-token authentication. The panel system supports 8 field types: text, number, date, dropdown, multiselect, boolean, longtext, and relation. Limits are enforced: max 10 panels per business, max 20 fields per panel. Frontend panels page at /seller/business-tools/panels compiles and loads correctly. Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login.
